title: Tray icon missing on GNOME (Wayland) in 44.0.0 / 43.4.1+: StatusNotifierItem registration is rejected
body:
### Electron Version

44.0.0 (also 44.0.0-beta.6, 43.4.1, 43.4.2)

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

Ubuntu 24.04, GNOME with the default ubuntu-appindicators extension, Wayland and Xorg sessions

### What arch are you using?

x64, arm64

### Last Known Working Electron version

44.0.0-beta.5 / 43.4.0 (icon registers; see #52674 for the separate menu problem those had), 42.x fully working

### Expected Behavior

`new Tray(image)` registers a StatusNotifierItem with `org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher` and the icon shows in the GNOME top bar.

### Actual Behavior

Nothing is registered with the watcher (`busctl --user get-property org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher /StatusNotifierWatcher org.kde.StatusNotifierWatcher RegisteredStatusNotifierItems` never lists the app). On Wayland there is no tray icon at all; on Xorg the legacy XEmbed fallback icon appears instead.

The item calls `RegisterStatusNotifierItem("org.freedesktop.StatusNotifierItem-<pid>-1/StatusNotifierItem/1")`, i.e. the well-known name with the object path appended. GNOME's watcher treats an argument that does not start with `/` as a bus name, `GetNameOwner` fails on that string, and the registration is refused, after which the SNI implementation is torn down. This came in with the cherry-pick of https://crrev.com/c/8250459 in #52951 (44-x-y) and #52952 (43-x-y); upstream fixed it a week later in https://crrev.com/c/8272040 (in Chromium 154.0.8016.0, so `main` already has it), which registers the plain well-known name and exports the item at `/StatusNotifierItem` again.

### Testcase Gist URL

```js
const { app, Tray, Menu, nativeImage } = require('electron');
app.on('ready', () => {
  const t = new Tray(nativeImage.createFromPath('icon.png'));
  t.setContextMenu(Menu.buildFromTemplate([{ label: 'Quit', role: 'quit' }]));
});
```

Per-version result against a watcher that resolves items the way the GNOME extension does:

| version | RegisterStatusNotifierItem argument | result |
|---|---|---|
| 42.10.0 | `:1.1` | ok |
| 43.4.0, 44.0.0-beta.5 | `org.freedesktop.StatusNotifierItem-<pid>-1` | registered (menu issue is #52674) |
| 43.4.1, 44.0.0-beta.6, 44.0.0 | `org.freedesktop.StatusNotifierItem-<pid>-1/StatusNotifierItem/1` | `NameHasNoOwner`, registration refused |
